optimized_sql:
SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_salutation, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_preferred_cust_flag, c.c_birth_day, c.c_birth_month, c.c_birth_year, c.c_birth_country, c.c_login, c.c_email_address, c.c_last_review_date_sk, ctr.ctr_total_return
FROM (
    SELECT wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, ca_r.ca_state AS ctr_state, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return,
           AVG(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_r.ca_state) * 1.2 AS avg_ctr_total_return
    FROM web_returns AS wr
    JOIN date_dim AS dd
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
        AND dd.d_year = 2000
    JOIN customer_address AS ca_r
        ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_r.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_r.ca_state
) AS ctr
JOIN customer AS c
    ON ctr.ctr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address AS ca_c
    ON ca_c.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    AND ca_c.ca_state = 'AR'
WHERE ctr.ctr_total_return > ctr.avg_ctr_total_return
  AND ctr.ctr_state IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_salutation, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_preferred_cust_flag, c.c_birth_day, c.c_birth_month, c.c_birth_year, c.c_birth_country, c.c_login, c.c_email_address, c.c_last_review_date_sk, ctr.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
